column1: # The game's structs: the single source for tools/cmod/structs.h (C mods) and the Ghidra types
# (symbols/ImportBeatdownSymbols.py). Regenerate both with: python tools/codemap.py symbols ISO/SLUS_211.50 symbols
# One line per field: struct, offset, type, name, comment. A line with offset "size" starts a struct and gives
# its size in bytes ("?" = not known yet; the struct then ends after its last field) and its description.
# Types: s8 u8 s16 u16 s32 u32 s64 u64 f32, void, char, another struct defined above, then any number of "*",
# then an optional [count]. Gaps between fields become padding. Only add fields that the code or a test
# confirms; say how sure a field is in its comment when it's a guess.
